## Description
Briefly describe the proposed changes or new features added to ASFL-IoT.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature / extension (e.g., new Byzantine attack, aggregator, DP accountant)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Benchmark / experiment reproduction improvement

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have run `pytest` and all tests pass locally
- [ ] All updated or new figures have been verified
